subject: MAP: POC environment activation & network handoff
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alec Turner <alec.turner@acuitylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC environment activation & network handoff

Hi Alec,

Thanks again for the time today. Attached is a one-page MAP draft that lays out the POC environment activation we discussed. High-level asks from our side to get the POC live:

- Org setup: create Acuity tenant + inviteing 2 admin users (expected: 24–48h)
- API keys: provision a scoped API key for the POC (read/write tokens, short TTL)
- IP allowlist: provide the list of egress IPs we should add to your firewall for test traffic
- VPC peering: schedule peering for the staging VPC (optional: customer-managed peering)

Target timeline (proposed):
1) Week 0 (this week): org + admin invites
2) Week 1: API key provisioning + test calls
3) Week 2: IP allowlist + initial traffic
4) Week 3: VPC peering cutover (if needed) and performance validation

Can you confirm your network contact for the peering and whether your security/compliance team requires a canned questionnaire before we share IPs? I attached the MAP spreadsheet to annotate responsibilities.

Next step: if this looks good I can open a HubSpot mutual-action task and book a 30-minute network alignment with your engineer.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_ACUITY_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: MAP milestones)
From: Alec Turner <alec.turner@acuitylabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment activation & network handoff

Jordan,

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifications:

- Security: we will need a short SOC2 addendum and a completed security questionnaire before sharing production IP ranges. Our security lead is Sandeep Rao (cced).
- Network: I own the peering request but will hand off the technical aspects to our infra engineer, Priya (priya@acuitylabs.com). Can she be looped in on the network call?
- Keys: could you confirm whether the API key supports IP restrictions on Redwood's side or if we should enforce from our firewall only?

If you can get the questionnaire to Sandeep, we'll turn it around quickly. Let's tentatively schedule the alignment call Friday at 10am PT — is that feasible?

Thanks,
Alec

Alec Turner
Head of Product
Acuity Labs
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alec Turner <alec.turner@acuitylabs.com>, Priya <priya@acuitylabs.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment activation & network handoff

Alec — looping in Naomi (technical account lead) and attaching a draft network diagram and a short VPC peering SOW for your infra team to review. Priya — welcome, we can cover the CIDR ranges and routing during the call.

Quick notes:
- Redwood can generate scoped API keys; we support optional client-IP allowlist on the key (recommended for early POC). We will send the SOC2 addendum and a lightweight questionnaire to Sandeep within the hour.
- If Acuity prefers customer-managed peering, we will coordinate the route tables and BGP details; if not, we can provision an application layer fallback.

Attachments: network-diagram-acuity.png, vpc-peering-sow.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alec Turner <alec.turner@acuitylabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 May 2028 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment activation & network handoff

Alec / Priya — confirmed for Friday 10am PT. Calendar invite sent. Action items before the call:

- Redwood: send SOC2 addendum + questionnaire (Marissa)
- Acuity: identify network owner (Priya) and share preferred CIDR range options for peer
- Acuity: decision on whether you want key-level IP restriction (yes/no)

HubSpot deal & MAP: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/AC-3742 — I'll create the mutual-action board and add owners + ETA per task. Please add comments directly in the MAP spreadsheet after the call.

If you want keys earlier for dev testing, we can provision a time-limited token within 24 hours of getting the org admin invite.

Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment activation & network handoff

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround. Sandeep reviewed the questionnaire and only asked one small clarification about data retention settings; Marissa answered inline. Priya confirmed Fri 10am PT works and shared two candidate CIDR ranges (10.20.0.0/16 and 10.21.0.0/16). Priya prefers customer-managed peering.

Next steps for closure:
- Priya to submit peering request and share ticket id (expected Mon)
- Redwood to provision scoped API key with client-IP restriction once CIDR is shared
- Acuity to complete the mutual-action tasks in HubSpot (I'll assign Priya)

We're green to start API test calls next week.

Cheers,
Alec
